```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
source(file.path("R", "common.R"))
library(knitr)
```

This notebook supports the Results section "True coding regions that fail the coding test, and two
fallbacks", including its paragraph "Homology evidence recovers true coding regions, mostly in
fragments" ([`../manuscript/sections/results_coding_failures.tex`](../manuscript/sections/results_coding_failures.tex)),
and draws Fig. 5 (`fig:failures`, `figures/fig5_failures.{pdf,png}`). Provenance:
`r evidence("E12")` (the coding-failure analysis), `r evidence("E07")` (homology runs of the
benchmark) and `r evidence("E25")` (final release runs).

**Release rule.** The analysis of E12 used the development rule: $S_1>0$, frame contrast
$C=S_1-\max(S_2,S_3)>0$ and, below 300 nt, a fixed short-ORF test ($C \ge 200\mu$). The text now
quotes the release analysis. Here the analysis is rerun on the release predictions
(`pytd_v7`: PyTD 3a793ff, release defaults; Perl gives identical predictions, E25), with the
release coding test: $S_1>0$, $C>0$ and target-decoy q-value $\le 0.05$. The q-value of each
candidate is read from the run's `decoy_qvalues.tsv`.

Data (`data/long_orf_failures/v7/`, written by `pipeline/derive/05_long_orf_failures_v7.sh`, which
runs `05_long_orf_failures_v7.py`, `05_summarize_v7.py`, `05_length_vs_homology_v7.py` and
`05_fig5_tables_v7.py`; these are copies of `analyses/long_orf_failures/*.py` changed for the
release rule):

- the matched CDS tables of the 8 benchmark organisms (complete transcripts, UTRs trimmed to 250 nt),
  aggregated: by organism, length, GC3 quintile, chromosome, failure cause, and model;
- homology flags from the release homology runs (`pytd_v7_homology`), which search all LongOrfs
  ORFs ($\ge$ 50 aa) against Swiss-Prot (minus the organism's own entries) and Pfam. E12 used older
  runs with a 100-aa minimum, so CDSs of 50--99 aa now have homology flags;
- the truth-trained Markov models of E12 (two folds by gene) now pass an ORF only if it also has a
  q-value $\le 0.05$ computed from decoys scored with the same model. The decoys are regenerated as
  PyTD generates them; with the run's own model this reproduces every q-value in `decoy_qvalues.tsv`
  (checked below);
- the homology comparison (Fig. 5d,e) uses `data/benchmark/homology_v7h_vs_abinitio.tsv`: the
  released homology mode (PyTD a5b24c3, homology-assisted start refinement; runs `pytd_v7h_homology`)
  minus the ab initio release runs (`pytd_v7`), from `benchmark_v2/scripts/compare_homology.py` on
  `data/benchmark/final_v7/v7h_homology_scores.tsv` (`pipeline/derive/05_homology_v7h_table.sh`; E25
  addendum of 2026-10-28, E33). Selection and stops equal the earlier 3a793ff homology runs
  (`pytd_v7_homology`, `homology_vs_abinitio.tsv`, kept and compared below); only start codons differ.
  The development comparison (`pytd_dev_v2_homology` minus `pytd_dev_v2`) is kept as
  `homology_vs_abinitio.dev_v2.tsv`.

```{r data}
V7 <- function(f) read_tab("long_orf_failures", "v7", f)
by_org <- V7("summary_by_org.tsv")
by_len <- V7("summary_by_length.tsv")
oracle <- V7("oracle_models.tsv")
flags <- V7("explanation_flags.tsv")
rate_feat <- V7("fail_rate_by_feature.tsv")
by_chr <- V7("fail_by_chromosome.tsv") %>% mutate(seqid = as.character(seqid))
rp <- V7("ribosomal_proteins.tsv")
feat <- V7("features_fail_vs_pass.tsv")
fam <- V7("family_keyword_enrichment.tsv")
utr <- V7("utr_effect.tsv")
meta <- V7("org_meta.tsv")
lvh <- V7("length_vs_homology_fallback.tsv")
lro <- V7("length_rule_only_predictions.tsv") %>%
  separate(dataset, c("src", "org", "input"), sep = ":", remove = FALSE)
alt <- V7("alt_rules_negatives.tsv")
dmel_c <- V7("dmel_gc3_rescue.tsv")
long_fail <- V7("failing_ge1kb.tsv")
reasons <- V7("reasons_by_length.tsv")
hom <- read_tab("benchmark", "homology_v7h_vs_abinitio.tsv")
hom_3a7 <- read_tab("benchmark", "homology_vs_abinitio.tsv")  # 3a793ff homology runs (no start assist)
# development-rule tables of E12, for comparison
dev_by_org <- read_tab("long_orf_failures", "summary_by_org.tsv")
dev_by_len <- read_tab("long_orf_failures", "summary_by_length.tsv")

ALL <- by_org %>% filter(org == "ALL")
LEN_BINS <- c("0-299", "300-599", "600-999", "1000-1999", "2000-4999", ">=5000")
```

## Release runs and reproduction checks

```{r checks-repro}
repro <- meta %>% transmute(org, run, homology_source, L_star, n_truth, n_training, training_is_truth_cds,
                            q_values = check_td_q_n, q_identical = check_td_q_identical,
                            score_diffs = check_td_scores_ndiff_gt0.011, decoy_orfs = n_decoy_orfs,
                            shuffles = n_decoy_shuffles)
kable(repro)
stopifnot(all(repro$q_identical == repro$q_values), all(repro$score_diffs == 0))
```

For every organism, the Markov scores recomputed here equal `longest_orfs.cds.scores`, and the
q-values recomputed from the regenerated decoys equal `decoy_qvalues.tsv` for all
`r num(sum(repro$q_values))` LongOrfs candidates. The same code therefore gives valid q-values for
the truth-trained models below.

## How often

```{r how-often}
fail_pct <- ALL$fail_coding_pct
len_all <- by_len %>% filter(org == "ALL") %>% mutate(cds_len_bin = factor(cds_len_bin, LEN_BINS)) %>% arrange(cds_len_bin)
lp <- setNames(len_all$fail_coding_pct, as.character(len_all$cds_len_bin))
reason_short <- len_all %>% filter(cds_len_bin == "0-299")
n_ge1kb <- nrow(long_fail)
named <- c("Muc14A", "kl-2", "kl-3", "MUC4", "FLG", "HRNR", "COL4A4", "ELN")
named_tab <- long_fail %>% filter(gene_name %in% named) %>%
  group_by(org, gene_name) %>% slice_max(cds_len, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(org, gene_name, cds_len, fail_reason, category, decoy_q)
dev_all <- dev_by_org %>% filter(org == "ALL")
```

Of `r num(ALL$n_matched)` annotated CDSs matched to a LongOrfs candidate
(`r num(ALL$n_truth)` truth CDSs; E12 matched `r num(dev_all$n_matched)`), **`r f1(fail_pct)`%**
fail the release coding test (development rule: `r f1(dev_all$fail_coding_pct)`%). By cause:
$S_1 \le 0$ `r num(ALL$fail_S1_le0)`, shifted frame $\ge S_1$ `r num(ALL$fail_shifted_frame)`,
q-value above 0.05 `r num(ALL$fail_decoy_q)`. `r evidence("E12")` `r evidence("E25")`

The failure rate by annotated CDS length (all organisms):

```{r how-often-len}
cmp_len <- len_all %>% select(cds_len_bin, n, fail_coding, fail_coding_pct, fail_S1_le0, fail_shifted_frame,
                              fail_decoy_q, rescued_by_long_rule, still_lost, still_lost_pct) %>%
  left_join(dev_by_len %>% filter(org == "ALL") %>% select(cds_len_bin, dev_n = n, dev_fail_pct = fail_coding_pct),
            by = "cds_len_bin")
kable(cmp_len, caption = "All organisms, release rule; dev_*: development rule (E12).")
```

- below 300 nt: `r f1(lp[["0-299"]])`% (`r num(reason_short$fail_decoy_q)` of
  `r num(reason_short$fail_coding)` failures through the q-value; development rule 67%, mostly
  the fixed short-ORF test);
- 300--599 nt: `r f1(lp[["300-599"]])`%; 600--999 nt: `r f1(lp[["600-999"]])`%;
- 1--2 kb: `r f1(lp[["1000-1999"]])`%; 2--5 kb: `r f1(lp[["2000-4999"]])`%; $\ge$ 5 kb:
  `r f1(lp[[">=5000"]])`%.

Failing CDSs of at least 1 kb: **`r num(n_ge1kb)`**. The named genes of the text:

```{r named-genes}
kable(named_tab)
```

Genes named in the text and not failing under the release rule:
`r paste(setdiff(named, named_tab$gene_name), collapse = ", ")`.
The longest failing CDSs per organism:

```{r long-examples}
kable(long_fail %>% group_by(org) %>% slice_max(cds_len, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
        select(org, gene_name, transcript_id, cds_len, fail_reason, category))
```

### The length rule

```{r length-rule}
tt_len <- by_len %>% filter(org == "tthermophila", cds_len_bin %in% c("1000-1999", "2000-4999", ">=5000"))
tt_lost_1kb <- sum(tt_len$still_lost)
# failing CDSs with an ORF at or above L* that the rule does not keep (should be T. thermophila only)
above_lstar <- by_len %>% filter(org != "ALL") %>% group_by(org) %>%
  summarise(rescued = sum(rescued_by_long_rule), still_lost = sum(still_lost), .groups = "drop")
lvh_all <- lvh %>% filter(org == "ALL")
lo_pct <- 100 * lvh_all$length_only / lvh_all$rescued_by_length
kable(lvh, caption = "Failing true CDSs retained by the length rule, and whether they also have a homology hit.")
```

The length rule keeps every failing CDS whose ORF reaches $L^\ast$; it is off in
*T. thermophila*, where `r num(tt_lost_1kb)` failing CDSs of at least 1 kb are lost. In total it
retains **`r num(lvh_all$rescued_by_length)`** failing true CDSs; **`r num(lvh_all$length_only)`**
(`r f1(lo_pct)`%) of them have no Swiss-Prot or Pfam hit. `r evidence("E12")`

### Not predicted, and predictions kept by length alone

```{r lost}
lost_pct <- ALL$fail_lost_pct_of_matched
lro_b <- lro %>% filter(src == "bench_v3")
lro_cplt <- lro_b %>% filter(input == "complete")
lo_total <- sum(lro_cplt$length_rule_only)
lo_false <- sum(lro_cplt$length_rule_only - lro_cplt$lo_is_truth_cds)
h_lnc <- lro_b %>% filter(org == "human", input == "complete.wLnc")
kable(lro_b %>% select(org, input, L_star, predictions, length_rule_only, length_rule_only_pct, lo_is_truth_cds,
                       lo_on_negative_transcript, lo_other_orf_on_coding_transcript))
```

**`r f1(lost_pct)`%** of matched true CDSs fail the coding test and are not retained by the length
rule. Predictions kept by length alone are `r f1(min(lro_b$length_rule_only_pct))`--`r f1(max(lro_b$length_rule_only_pct))`%
of all predictions. On complete transcripts `r num(lo_false)` of `r num(lo_total)` are not the
annotated CDS; on human lncRNA negatives `r num(h_lnc$lo_is_truth_cds)` are true and
`r num(h_lnc$lo_on_negative_transcript)` are on lncRNAs. `r evidence("E12")`

## Why

### Exclusive attribution (failures of at least 300 nt)

```{r attribution}
attr_lab <- c(atypical_gc3_composition = "atypical GC3", low_complexity_or_repetitive = "low complexity / repetitive",
              no_homology_orphan = "no homology", stronger_out_of_frame_orf = "stronger ORF in another frame",
              unexplained = "unexplained")
attr <- flags %>% filter(startsWith(flag, "attr:")) %>% mutate(cause = sub("attr:", "", flag))
attr_all <- attr %>% filter(org == "ALL") %>% { setNames(.$fail_pct, .$cause) }
kable(attr %>% select(org, cause, n_fail, fail_pct) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cause, values_from = fail_pct))
```

Of `r num(attr %>% filter(org == "ALL") %>% pull(n_fail) %>% first())` failures of at least 300 nt:
atypical GC3 `r f1(attr_all[["atypical_gc3_composition"]])`%, low complexity
`r f1(attr_all[["low_complexity_or_repetitive"]])`%, no homology `r f1(attr_all[["no_homology_orphan"]])`%,
stronger ORF in another frame `r f1(attr_all[["stronger_out_of_frame_orf"]])`% (the last two together
`r f1(attr_all[["no_homology_orphan"]] + attr_all[["stronger_out_of_frame_orf"]])`%), unexplained
`r f1(attr_all[["unexplained"]])`%. `r evidence("E12")`

### Codon-usage heterogeneity

```{r gc3}
dq <- rate_feat %>% filter(org == "dmel", feature == "gc3") %>% arrange(quintile)
chr4 <- by_chr %>% filter(org == "dmel", seqid == "4")
chrY <- by_chr %>% filter(org == "dmel", seqid == "Y")
tt_rp <- rp %>% filter(org == "tthermophila")
o_all <- oracle %>% filter(org == "ALL")
o_dmel <- oracle %>% filter(org == "dmel")
other_models <- c(o_all$all_fail_ge300_pct, o_all$rand500_fail_ge300_pct, o_all$long500_fail_ge300_pct)
purity <- meta$training_is_truth_cds / meta$n_training
kable(dq %>% select(quintile, lo, hi, n, fail_score, fail_score_pct), caption = "D. melanogaster, ORFs >= 300 nt, by GC3 quintile.")
kable(oracle %>% select(org, n, td_fail_pct, td_fail_ge300_pct, all_fail_ge300_pct, rand500_fail_ge300_pct,
                        long500_fail_ge300_pct, gc3match500_fail_ge300_pct, td_scorefail_n,
                        gc3match500_rescues_td_scorefail_pct),
      caption = "Failure rates (%) under TransDecoder's model (td) and truth-trained models; rescue by the GC3-matched model.")
```

- *D. melanogaster*: `r f1(dq$fail_score_pct[1])`% of CDSs ($\ge$ 300 nt) in the lowest GC3 quintile
  fail, against `r f1(min(dq$fail_score_pct[-1]))`--`r f1(max(dq$fail_score_pct[-1]))`% in the
  others; chromosome 4 `r chr4$fail_score` of `r chr4$n`, chromosome Y `r chrY$fail_score` of
  `r chrY$n`.
- *T. thermophila* ribosomal proteins: `r tt_rp$rp_fail` of `r tt_rp$n_rp` fail.
- GC3-matched model: rescues `r f1(o_all$gc3match500_rescues_td_scorefail_pct)`% of failures overall
  and `r f1(o_dmel$gc3match500_rescues_td_scorefail_pct)`% in *D. melanogaster*;
  `r chr4$rescued_gc3_model` of the `r chr4$fail_score` on chromosome 4.
- Models trained on all annotated CDSs, 500 random or the 500 longest: `r f1(min(other_models))`--`r f1(max(other_models))`%
  of ORFs $\ge$ 300 nt fail, against `r f1(o_all$td_fail_ge300_pct)`% with TransDecoder's model.
  TransDecoder's training ORFs are `r f1(100 * min(purity))`--`r f1(100 * max(purity))`% annotated CDSs.

`r evidence("E12")`

### Low-complexity and repetitive proteins

```{r lowc}
hm <- flags %>% filter(org %in% c("human", "mouse"), flag == "f_low_complexity")
lowc_fail <- sum(hm$n_fail * hm$fail_pct) / sum(hm$n_fail)
lowc_ctrl <- sum(hm$n_ctrl * hm$ctrl_pct) / sum(hm$n_ctrl)
hm_shift <- by_org %>% filter(org %in% c("human", "mouse")) %>% select(org, fail_coding, fail_S1_le0, fail_shifted_frame, fail_decoy_q)
krtap <- fam %>% filter(org == "human", kind == "name_prefix", term == "KRTAP")
fh <- feat %>% filter(org == "human", feature %in% c("aa_C", "aa_S", "aa_G", "aa_P", "seg_lowc_frac")) %>%
  select(feature, n_fail, n_ctrl, fail_mean, ctrl_mean, mannwhitney_p)
cys <- fh %>% filter(feature == "aa_C")
seg <- fh %>% filter(feature == "seg_lowc_frac")
kable(hm_shift, caption = "Human and mouse failures by cause (all lengths).")
kable(fh, digits = 4, caption = "Human, failing ORFs >= 300 nt vs length-matched passing controls.")
```

- `r f1(lowc_fail)`% of human and mouse failures ($\ge$ 300 nt) are low-complexity or repetitive,
  against `r f1(lowc_ctrl)`% of length-matched passing CDSs.
- Human *KRTAP*: `r if (nrow(krtap)) paste(krtap$n_fail, "of", krtap$n) else "fewer than 3"` fail.
- Failing human CDSs: Cys `r f1(100 * cys$fail_mean)`% vs `r f1(100 * cys$ctrl_mean)`%;
  low-complexity fraction `r f3(seg$fail_mean)` vs `r f3(seg$ctrl_mean)`
  (`r f1(seg$fail_mean / seg$ctrl_mean)`-fold).

`r evidence("E12")`

### Unconserved gene models

```{r orphans}
tt_orph <- flags %>% filter(org == "tthermophila", flag == "f_orphan")
tt_alt <- flags %>% filter(org == "tthermophila", flag == "f_altframe_orf_stronger")
sp <- rate_feat %>% filter(feature == "has_sprot") %>% select(org, has_sprot = quintile, n, fail_score, fail_score_pct)
h_sp <- sp %>% filter(org == "human")
kable(sp %>% pivot_wider(names_from = has_sprot, values_from = c(n, fail_score, fail_score_pct)),
      caption = "Failure rate (ORFs >= 300 nt) by Swiss-Prot hit (0: none, 1: hit).")
```

- *T. thermophila*: `r f1(tt_orph$fail_pct)`% of failures have no Swiss-Prot or Pfam hit, against
  `r f1(tt_orph$ctrl_pct)`% of controls; `r f1(tt_alt$fail_pct)`% have a stronger ORF in another frame.
- Human: `r f1(h_sp$fail_score_pct[h_sp$has_sprot == 0])`% of CDSs without a Swiss-Prot hit fail,
  against `r f1(h_sp$fail_score_pct[h_sp$has_sprot == 1])`% with one.

`r evidence("E12")`

### UTR length

```{r utr}
kable(utr %>% select(org, n_trim, n_full, fail_pct_trim, fail_pct_full, predicted_pct_trim, predicted_pct_full,
                     category_changed, lost_only_in_full, lost_only_in_full_outcompeted))
```

Complete transcripts with UTRs trimmed to 250 nt (`trim`) and with full UTRs (`full`). The failure
rate differs by at most `r f1(max(abs(utr$fail_pct_full - utr$fail_pct_trim)))` points; CDSs predicted
with trimmed but not with full UTRs are mostly out-competed by another ORF
(`r num(sum(utr$lost_only_in_full_outcompeted))` of `r num(sum(utr$lost_only_in_full))`).
`r evidence("E12")`

## Implications

```{r altrules}
alt_r <- alt %>% filter(input == "complete.wRand") %>%
  mutate(pos_gain_pct = 100 * (pos_pass_A_no_S1 - pos_pass_current) / n_pos,
         neg_fold = neg_with_candidate_A_no_S1 / neg_with_candidate_current)
kable(alt %>% select(org, input, n_pos, n_neg, pos_pass_current, pos_pass_A_no_S1, neg_with_candidate_current,
                     neg_with_candidate_A_no_S1, check_q_identical, check_q_n))
kable(alt_r %>% select(org, pos_gain_pct, neg_fold), digits = 2)
```

Dropping $S_1>0$ (keeping $C>0$ and the q-value, recomputed with $C>0$ as the only eligibility
condition) adds `r sprintf("%.2f", min(alt_r$pos_gain_pct))`--`r f1(max(alt_r$pos_gain_pct))`% of
true CDSs as candidates, while the number of random sequences with a candidate changes
`r f1(min(alt_r$neg_fold))`- to `r f1(max(alt_r$neg_fold))`-fold (median
`r f1(median(alt_r$neg_fold))`). Candidate counts are upper bounds on calls (one ORF per transcript
is kept). `r evidence("E12")`

## Homology evidence recovers true coding regions, mostly in fragments

Release runs (`pytd_v7` vs `pytd_v7h_homology`, PyTD a5b24c3 with the homology-assisted start
refinement; `data/benchmark/homology_v7h_vs_abinitio.tsv`). `r evidence("E25")` `r evidence("E33")`

```{r homology}
hom <- hom %>% mutate(kind = case_when(grepl("wLnc", variant) ~ "lnc",
                                       startsWith(variant, "complete") ~ "complete",
                                       startsWith(variant, "fragments") ~ "fragments"))
rng <- function(x) c(min(x), max(x))
hc <- hom %>% filter(kind == "complete")
hf <- hom %>% filter(kind == "fragments")
hneg <- hom %>% filter(kind != "lnc")
frag_s <- hom %>% filter(variant == "fragments") %>% { setNames(100 * .$d_f1_exact, .$org) }
rand <- hom %>% filter(grepl("wRand", variant)) %>% mutate(d_neg = neg_pred_homology - neg_pred_abinitio)
rand_other <- rand %>% filter(org != "tthermophila")
rand_tt <- rand %>% filter(org == "tthermophila")
lnc <- hom %>% filter(kind == "lnc")
lncv <- function(o, v, col) lnc %>% filter(org == o, variant == v) %>% pull({{ col }})
kable(hom %>% count(kind), caption = "Inputs per kind.")
# the start assist changes start codons only: stop-level columns must equal the 3a793ff homology table
STOP_COLS <- c("n_pred_abinitio", "n_pred_homology", "d_sensitivity_stop", "d_precision_stop", "d_f1_stop",
               "f1_exact_abinitio", "neg_pred_abinitio", "neg_pred_homology")
same_stop <- hom %>% select(org, variant, all_of(STOP_COLS)) %>%
  inner_join(hom_3a7 %>% select(org, variant, all_of(STOP_COLS)), by = c("org", "variant"), suffix = c("", ".old"))
stopifnot(nrow(same_stop) == 84,
          all(sapply(STOP_COLS, function(c) identical(as.character(same_stop[[c]]), as.character(same_stop[[paste0(c, ".old")]])))))
cmp_3a7 <- hom %>% select(org, variant, d_f1_exact) %>%
  inner_join(hom_3a7 %>% select(org, variant, d_f1_exact_3a793ff = d_f1_exact), by = c("org", "variant")) %>%
  mutate(kind = case_when(grepl("wLnc", variant) ~ "lnc", startsWith(variant, "complete") ~ "complete", TRUE ~ "fragments"))
kable(cmp_3a7 %>% group_by(kind) %>%
        summarise(n = n(), median_d_f1_exact_a5b24c3 = 100 * median(d_f1_exact),
                  median_d_f1_exact_3a793ff = 100 * median(d_f1_exact_3a793ff)), digits = 2,
      caption = "Exact F1 change (points), homology minus ab initio: released homology mode (a5b24c3) vs 3a793ff homology runs. Stop-level columns are identical (checked).")
```

- Complete transcripts (`r nrow(hc)` inputs): stop-level sensitivity
  `r sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * min(hc$d_sensitivity_stop))` to `r sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * max(hc$d_sensitivity_stop))` points;
  exact F1 `r f1(100 * min(hc$d_f1_exact))` to +`r f1(100 * max(hc$d_f1_exact))` points.
- Fragments (`r nrow(hf)` inputs): sensitivity +`r f1(100 * min(hf$d_sensitivity_stop))` to
  +`r f1(100 * max(hf$d_sensitivity_stop))`; exact F1 +`r f1(100 * min(hf$d_f1_exact))` to
  +`r f1(100 * max(hf$d_f1_exact))` points.
- Stranded fragments, exact F1: human +`r f1(frag_s[["human"]])`, mouse +`r f1(frag_s[["mouse"]])`,
  *A. thaliana* +`r f1(frag_s[["athal"]])`; the other five organisms
  +`r f1(min(frag_s[setdiff(names(frag_s), c("human", "mouse", "athal"))]))` to
  +`r f1(max(frag_s[setdiff(names(frag_s), c("human", "mouse", "athal"))]))` points.
- Stop-level precision, all inputs without lncRNAs: `r f1(100 * min(hneg$d_precision_stop))` to
  +`r f1(100 * max(hneg$d_precision_stop))` points. Calls on random sequences rose by
  `r min(rand_other$d_neg)`--`r max(rand_other$d_neg)` per input in seven organisms and
  `r min(rand_tt$d_neg)`--`r max(rand_tt$d_neg)` in *T. thermophila*.
- Human lncRNAs with a prediction: `r num(lncv("human", "complete.wLnc", neg_pred_abinitio))` to
  `r num(lncv("human", "complete.wLnc", neg_pred_homology))` (mouse
  `r num(lncv("mouse", "complete.wLnc", neg_pred_abinitio))` to `r num(lncv("mouse", "complete.wLnc", neg_pred_homology))`).
  Exact F1 with lncRNA negatives: complete human `r sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * lncv("human", "complete.wLnc", d_f1_exact))`,
  mouse `r sprintf("%+.1f", 100 * lncv("mouse", "complete.wLnc", d_f1_exact))`; fragments human
  +`r f1(100 * lncv("human", "fragments.wLnc", d_f1_exact))`, mouse
  +`r f1(100 * lncv("mouse", "fragments.wLnc", d_f1_exact))` points.

## Figure 5

```{r fig5-data}
SHORT <- c(pfalciparum = "P. falc.", tthermophila = "T. therm.", spombe = "S. pombe", athal = "A. thal.",
           dmel = "D. mel.", mouse = "M. mus.", human = "H. sap.", creinhardtii = "C. rein.")
BIN_LABEL <- c("<0.3", "0.3–\n0.6", "0.6–\n1", "1–2", "2–5", "≥5")
ATTR_COL <- c(atypical_gc3_composition = "#2c7fb8", low_complexity_or_repetitive = "#d95f02",
              no_homology_orphan = "#7570b3", stronger_out_of_frame_orf = "#e6ab02", unexplained = "#bdbdbd")
it <- function(x) x  # organism labels are set in italic through element_text below

pa_org <- by_len %>% filter(org != "ALL") %>%
  mutate(bin = factor(cds_len_bin, LEN_BINS, BIN_LABEL), org = factor(org, ORGS)) %>%
  filter(fail_coding_pct > 0)
pa_all <- by_len %>% filter(org == "ALL") %>% mutate(bin = factor(cds_len_bin, LEN_BINS, BIN_LABEL)) %>%
  select(bin, `all, failing` = fail_coding_pct, `all, still lost after length rule` = still_lost_pct) %>%
  pivot_longer(-bin, names_to = "series", values_to = "pct") %>% filter(pct > 0)
pb <- attr %>% mutate(org = factor(org, rev(c(ORGS, "ALL")), labels = rev(c(SHORT[ORGS], "all"))),
                      cause = factor(cause, names(ATTR_COL)))
pb_n <- pb %>% distinct(org, n_fail)
pc <- dmel_c %>% filter(group != "other_chr") %>%
  mutate(x = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.6, 6.6)[match(group, c(paste0("gc3_q", 1:5), "chr4", "chrY"))],
         lab = c("Q1\n(low)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5\n(high)", "4", "Y")[match(x, c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.6, 6.6))],
         fail_pct = 100 * fail_score / n, rescued_pct = 100 * rescued_gc3_model / n,
         label = ifelse(group %in% c("gc3_q1", "chr4", "chrY"), paste0(fail_score, "/", n), NA))
pde <- hom %>% filter(variant %in% c("complete", "fragments")) %>%
  mutate(org = factor(org, ORGS, labels = SHORT[ORGS]),
         sens = 100 * d_sensitivity_stop, f1x = 100 * d_f1_exact)
pf <- lvh %>% filter(org != "ALL", org != "tthermophila") %>%
  mutate(org = factor(org, rev(ORGS[ORGS != "tthermophila"]), labels = rev(SHORT[ORGS[ORGS != "tthermophila"]])))
```

```{r fig5, fig.width = FULL_W, fig.height = 140 * MM}
ital_y <- theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))
ital_x <- theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic", angle = 45, hjust = 1))
pA <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = pa_org, aes(bin, fail_coding_pct, colour = org, group = org), linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = pa_org, aes(bin, fail_coding_pct, colour = org), size = 0.7) +
  geom_line(data = pa_all, aes(bin, pct, linetype = series, group = series), linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ORG_COLOR, labels = SHORT, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100), labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100"), limits = c(0.015, 150)) +
  labs(x = "annotated CDS length (kb)", y = "true CDSs failing the coding test (%)") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 4, order = 2, override.aes = list(size = 0.8)),
         linetype = guide_legend(ncol = 1, order = 1, keywidth = unit(6, "mm"))) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.text = element_text(size = 5, face = "italic"),
        legend.key.size = unit(2.2, "mm"), legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
pB <- ggplot(pb, aes(fail_pct, org, fill = cause)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(data = pb_n, aes(x = 101, y = org, label = num(n_fail)), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0,
            size = 1.9, colour = "#444444") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ATTR_COL, labels = attr_lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 122), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "failures ≥300 nt (%)", y = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) + ital_y +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5), legend.key.size = unit(2.2, "mm"))
pC <- ggplot(pc, aes(x)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = fail_pct, fill = "fail"), width = 0.72) +
  geom_col(aes(y = rescued_pct, fill = "rescued by GC3-matched model"), width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(aes(y = fail_pct + 1, label = label), vjust = 0, size = 1.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4.8, colour = "#bbbbbb", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(fail = "#cfcfcf", `rescued by GC3-matched model` = COMPLETE_C), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pc$x, labels = pc$lab, expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(58, max(pc$fail_pct) + 6)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "GC3 quintile             chromosome", y = "CDSs ≥300 nt failing (%)", title = "D. melanogaster") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.5, 0.82), legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5))
hom_panel <- function(col, ylab) {
  ggplot(pde, aes(org, .data[[col]], fill = variant)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.55), width = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(complete = COMPLETE_C, fragments = FRAG_C), name = NULL) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, max(10, ceiling(max(pde$sens, pde$f1x))))) + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab) + ital_x
}
pD <- hom_panel("sens", "homology − ab initio:\nstop-level sensitivity (points)") + theme(legend.position = "top")
pE <- hom_panel("f1x", "homology − ab initio:\nexact-CDS F1 (points)") + theme(legend.position = "none")
lvh_all_lab <- sprintf("all: %d of %d length rule only", lvh_all$length_only, lvh_all$rescued_by_length)
pF <- pf %>% select(org, `also a homology hit` = also_homology_hit, `length rule only` = length_only) %>%
  pivot_longer(-org, names_to = "kind", values_to = "n") %>%
  ggplot(aes(n, org, fill = kind)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(data = pf, aes(x = rescued_by_length + 3, y = org, label = paste0(length_only, "/", rescued_by_length)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 1.9, colour = "#444444") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`also a homology hit` = "#9ecae1", `length rule only` = TD_C), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(pf$rescued_by_length) * 1.25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "failing true CDSs kept by\nthe length rule", y = NULL, title = lvh_all_lab) + ital_y +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.7, 0.2), axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
fig5 <- (pA | pB | pC) / (pD | pE | pF) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.85)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
save_fig(fig5, "fig5_failures", width = FULL_W, height = 150 * MM)
fig5
```

## Development rule vs release rule

```{r dev-vs-release}
cmp_org <- by_org %>% select(org, n_matched, fail_coding_pct, fail_ge300_pct_of_ge300, rescued_by_long_rule,
                             fail_lost_pct_of_matched) %>%
  left_join(dev_by_org %>% select(org, dev_n_matched = n_matched, dev_fail_coding_pct = fail_coding_pct,
                                  dev_fail_ge300_pct = fail_ge300_pct_of_ge300,
                                  dev_rescued_by_long_rule = rescued_by_long_rule,
                                  dev_fail_lost_pct = fail_lost_pct_of_matched), by = "org")
kable(cmp_org)
```

The release matched more CDSs than E12 for some organisms; the main difference is below 300 nt,
where the q-value test replaces the fixed short-ORF test.
